QuestInfo.name: Searching for Fossils
QuestInfo.0: I hear that #p512# the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the east side of Perion...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p512##k, an archaeologist I ran into in the Rocky Mountains east of Perion, has lost the fossils he's meticulously been collecting in the region. He asked me to bring back #b12 #t4031068#s#k and #b12 #t4031069#s#k, which have been stolen by #r#o13#s#k and #r#o15#s#k. How could he lose such important things? He's more careless than he looks...
QuestInfo.2: I found the fossils that #b#p512##k lost.

0.0: Hello, there, nice to meet you. I'm #b#p512##k the archeologist, and I'm looking for fossils of prehistoric life.
0.1: #m10004000# may be a land of dry, rocky mountains today, but it used to be a fertile land full of tall trees and lots of creatures, much like #m10002000#. Can you believe that? I'm looking for evidence from that era. If you are not busy and all, can you help me out?

yes.0: Thank you. I ran into something odd yesterday. I went to Perion for some food, and when I came back, I found my tent raided by monsters. They took my fossils and ran away.
yes.1: Looking at the footprints, it seems like the culprits are #r#o13#s#k and #r#o15#s#k. Please go take care of them and gather up #b12 #t4031068#s#k and #b12 #t4031069#s#k for me. Thanks, and good luck!

no.0: Kids these days are so selfish, saying no to an old man's favor. Fine, please leave.

mob.0: Don't forget to take down the monsters too.

item.0: I don't think you've gathered them all up yet. These materials are important. Please try harder.
